h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thrissur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thrissur

items.pText: Thrissur gets rain on most days from June to September, and in many schools the playground stands empty for much of that time. A covered play area can keep children playing through the monsoon. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, churches and temple trusts, housing projects and parks in Thrissur at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,050 km away.

Often called the cultural capital of Kerala, Thrissur has a large number of schools and a steady flow of new apartment and villa projects around the town. Each order goes to Thrissur by road and is installed by our team or a dealer in south India. Send us the size of your ground or shed, its roof height and a few photos. We will reply with a layout drawing that marks the safe play area around each piece.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Planning a covered play area for the monsoon

c: Many Thrissur schools already have a roofed assembly area or a covered shed that can double as a play space. Measure the clear height under the roof, since the top of a play station must sit well below the beams. Leave the sides open for air so the floor dries between showers.

items.q: Can playground equipment be installed under a roof?
items.a: Yes, if there is enough clear height above the tallest piece. Send us the roof height and floor size, and we will suggest equipment that fits, with its safe play area marked.

items.q: Which installation method suits a covered floor?
items.a: Self-standing equipment can stand on a finished floor without digging. Grouting suits open ground, where posts can be set into concrete footings.
Yes. We make the equipment in Vasai East and send it about 1,050 km by road, then install it through our own team or a dealer in south India.
